problem.text: The architecture registry lacked DeciLMForCausalLM, so Config.from_directory could not select a DeciLM implementation.

reasoning.text: The implementation represents heterogeneous decoder blocks using existing attention, gated-MLP and optional-branch machinery rather than introducing another execution backend.

impact.text: Architecture discovery now selects DeciLMConfig and DeciLMModel. This enables construction of the supported block forms, but does not establish compatibility with every Nemotron checkpoint.

source_notes.text: Whole-parent literal searches found no DeciLM or Nemotron occurrences; these searches do not exclude dynamically supplied architectures.

The inspected discussions concern separate failures: “quantizing model: undefined symbol: __cxa_call_terminate,” “Qwen2.5 Coder 0.5B Instruct | ValueError: Unsupported type in stop_conditions,” and “Fix a tokenizer issue while converting models without a bos_token_id defined.” They provide no explicit attribution of this DeciLM change to those reports.

limitations: No model construction, tensor loading, conversion or GPU inference was executed. The Python check transcribed scalar dimension arithmetic only.

Reference inspection was limited to nvidia/Llama-3_1-Nemotron-51B-Instruct and its first tensor shard header. Configurations for Nemotron Ultra CPT, Ultra, Super, Qwen2.5-0.5B, TinyLlama, Phi-3, Mistral and Gemma were not read; no cross-model compatibility claim is made.
The numerical rationale for the MLP formula's factor 2/3 and the choice of 256-wide alignment is not established by the inspected sources.

chapters.title: DeciLM registration and heterogeneous decoder construction

claims.text: The new registry entry connects the architecture string to DeciLMConfig and DeciLMModel. Config.from_directory selects the configuration class, while Model.from_config invokes the model class stored by that configuration.

DeciLMConfig reads global hidden width and query-head count, derives head dimension by integer division when absent or false-valued, and requires one block_configs entry per declared hidden layer. Each block supplies attention and ffn dictionaries rather than a single global intermediate width and KV-head count.

A branch marked no_op creates neither its normalization nor its attention/MLP module. Present branches receive RMSNorm and are passed to TransformerBlock, whose forward method skips absent branches and applies residual additions for present ones. The new constructor always supplies a normalization for each present branch.
The earlier optional-transformer entry describes matching allocation strategies for attention-only and MLP-only blocks. DeciLM's branch construction uses that existing interface.

Checkpoint keys retain original block indices, but cache_layer_idx increments only for present attention modules. Attention.decode_flash_attn uses that dense index to retrieve KV storage. last_kv_module_idx tracks the final attention-bearing top-level module, allowing Model.prefill to stop there rather than process trailing MLP-only blocks or the output head.

For active FFNs, the constructor truncates 2 × ffn_mult × hidden_size / 3 to an integer and rounds that integer upward to a multiple of 256. Here 255 implements ceiling division; 256 is an alignment unit, not a dispatch threshold.

Scalar transcription for the inspected 51B configuration produced intermediate widths 7168, 14336 and 28672 for multipliers 1.3125, 2.625 and 5.25. These equal the corresponding first-shard gate/up tensor dimensions. This checks arithmetic and metadata, not model execution.

Input preparation delegates to prepare_for_attn. Its existing alternatives remain uncached SDPA, uncached Flash Attention and cached Flash Attention; uncached preparation rejects a supplied cache, while rectangular cached preparation checks page alignment and requires exactly one of past_len or cache_seqlens.

The implementation deliberately bounds its supported subset with assertions against active linear-replacement and sparsification branches and several sink-attention options. Reusing conventional modules keeps the integration small, but these checks are narrower than the commit message's unqualified Nemotron label.

findings.description: Directly treating n_heads_in_group as the KV-head count disagrees with the inspected 51B checkpoint's second block.
findings.trigger: Construct attention for block 1 of the pinned nvidia/Llama-3_1-Nemotron-51B-Instruct configuration, where n_heads_in_group is 16, hidden_size is 8192 and num_attention_heads is 64.
findings.expected_behavior: Construct K/V projection dimensions matching the stored [512, 8192] tensors: four KV heads of dimension 128.
findings.actual_behavior: DeciLMModel passes 16 as num_kv_heads, so Attention declares K/V output width 2048 and later reshapes using 16 heads. The checkpoint header instead has width 512. The first block happens to match because both 8 and 64/8 are 8. The separate linear-replacement assertion prevents complete construction of this exact checkpoint before loading reaches the mismatch.

verification.description: Compared the constructor argument, Attention projection/reshape dimensions and pinned tensor shapes. Whole-parent searches found no pre-existing DeciLM callers; the inspected generic construction route is Model.from_config through config.model_class.
verification.limits: Reach is established for generic model construction, not every external entry point. No tensor loading failure was executed.

verification.description: Calculated head dimension 128, patch width 2048 and quotient-based width 512 for group size 16.
verification.limits: Standard-library arithmetic only; no repository model or GPU kernel ran.

findings.description: Registering DeciLM does not make the inspected Nemotron-51B checkpoint constructible.
findings.trigger: Instantiate the pinned 51B configuration through DeciLMModel with assertions enabled; block 11 has active attention with replace_with_linear=true.
findings.expected_behavior: For complete compatibility with this checkpoint, construct its configured linear-replacement attention branch.
findings.actual_behavior: The constructor raises the explicit assertion “DeciLM: replace_with_linear not supported.” This is an intentional unsupported form, not evidence that all Nemotron variants fail.

verification.description: Compared the checkpoint's active replacement branch with the constructor assertion and inspected Model.from_config's indirect constructor call.
verification.limits: Constructor execution was not performed; compatibility assessment is limited to the inspected checkpoint and assertion-enabled execution.

annotation.summary: Adds DeciLM discovery and per-block model assembly using existing optional transformer branches; inspected Nemotron-51B metadata exposes unsupported linear replacements and a KV-head dimension mismatch.
